summary: Kanban EV is a heavy Vital Lacerda worker-placement game about running an electric vehicle assembly line, juggling interlocking production stages, R&D, and logistics under constant time pressure. It's dense with interconnected subsystems and rewards careful sequencing across long sessions rather than quick, casual plays.
praised: deeply interlocking systems that feel like genuinely managing a factory
strong payoff when the engine clicks together
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rules overhead
significant table presence and long playtime
theme feels more like a skin over the mechanisms to some players

interaction.kind: worker placement over shared action spaces
interaction.detail: Players compete for the same limited production and R&D action spaces and can block each other from key spots or race for track bonuses, while each maintains their own assembly line and resources on a personal board.

scoring.why: Points accrue from efficient production, completed vehicle orders, R&D advancement, and track bonuses.
scoring.how_you_win: Optimize your production line and complete more valuable orders and objectives than your opponents before the game ends.
